queries_run: Innolux credit rating OR downgrade OR loss 2026 Himax customer
Himax Technologies customer concentration risk 2026 guidance Q3 2026 results

findings.claim: 2025年Customer A（含關係企業）占營收24.0%（2023年28.7%、2024年26.4%）；Customer C 占7.8%；前兩大合計逾33%，前十大合計71.3%。
findings.excerpt: Our ten largest customers together accounted for approximately 74.1%, 73.6% and 71.3% of our revenues in 2023, 2024 and 2025, respectively. In 2023, 2024 and 2025, our two largest customers accounted for 10% or more of our net revenue: customer A and its affiliates accounted for 28.7%, 26.4% and 24.0% of our revenues, respectively; and customer C accounted for 11.0%, 8.3% and 7.8%, respectively.

findings.claim: 2025年底對Customer A應收帳款5,780萬美元，占應收帳款淨額約28.8%；公司自述集中度提高信用風險，且曾對部分客戶延長付款條件。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025, Item 3.D Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: As of December 31, 2025, our accounts receivable from Customer A and its affiliates were $57.8 million, which represented approximately 28.8% of our accounts receivable, net. The concentration of our accounts receivable exposes us to increased credit risk. Moreover, we have at times agreed to extend the payment terms for certain of our customers.

findings.claim: 2025年約73.8%營收來自總部在中國的客戶（2024年73.4%）。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025, Item 3.D Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: In 2024 and 2025, approximately 73.4% and 73.8% of our revenues, respectively, were from customers headquartered in the PRC.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋未找到Customer A身分的來源，也未找到客戶評等調降、破產或財測下修紀錄（查無不等於確認無事）；Innolux搜尋結果僅顯示其2026年Q2獲利，但未證實為Himax Customer A，故未列入。
